summary: Central shard system unit for grounded family evidence, owned-state blockers, cost modeling, and permanent shard boundary/support structure.

family.summary: Definition-side shard family evidence and player-facing descriptive grounding.

owned-state.summary: Owned-state blocker and save-owner seam conclusions for shard milestone state.

cost.summary: Shard cost evaluator model, staged runtime evidence, and remaining bounded uncertainty.

provenance.policy: Copy shard family, owned-state, and cost data into centralized shard views while preserving the committed boundary/model source or the regeneration command for transient extraction evidence.
provenance.transientProbePolicy: If a shard value is initially copied from a transient extraction report, record the command or DB-backed target-bundle identity that regenerates it before treating the embedded value as current.

archiveReview.reason: Shard family evidence is now rebuilt inside the shared shards unit from grounded milestones plus row, title, effect, cost, and save boundaries instead of shipping the old standalone summary as a live support input.

The live shard cost model now materializes through the DB-backed shard system and the planner consumes that DB-owned projection. Keep this file only as a historical snapshot while the DB-first lane settles.

Calibration checkpoints remain a distinct grounding input, but the live shard runtime now reads them through the DB-backed shard policy materialization rather than treating the committed file as the active owner.
Getter-list path semantics are now projected from the canonical shard cost formula model into the shared shard unit, so the standalone probe can move toward historical-only status.
Shard bonus-slot coverage now derives from reducer-owned shard family evidence inside the shared shard unit, while the row-0 mismatch still survives there as bounded contradiction context.
Typed schema clues are now preserved through the surviving shard boundaries and formula model, so the raw type probe should remain historical-only rather than a live shard support surface.
The active shard lane no longer consumes this probe directly; its narrowing facts are already folded into save-side and handoff boundaries, so it stays historical-only.
The active shard cost lane now reads verified parameter semantics from the canonical formula model instead of shipping this raw probe as a live support input.
Method-level shard cost evidence is preserved through the centralized shard unit and archive references are sufficient once shipped validation no longer depends on it.

The active shard-cost trace lane now cites only the canonical formula model and save-owner boundary surfaces, so the raw native probe remains historical-only provenance rather than an active trace dependency.

requirementsBeforeArchive: App, trace, and planner reads must resolve through the centralized shard unit or explicit projections of it.
Family, owned-state, and cost conclusions must remain individually explainable inside the shared shard system.
Historical shard probes can only move out of the live data root after their evidence is reproducible from centralized projections.
Any transient shard extraction used during consolidation must preserve the regeneration command that produced it.
